classification.response_matrices: executable-reproduced against the isolated direct route

source_confirmed.top_level_system: Claude top-level system text becomes a Responses developer message.
source_confirmed.message_level_system: Claude message-level system text becomes a Responses user message at the same history position and receives one outer system-reminder wrapper.
source_confirmed.prompt_cache_key: A deterministic UUID is derived from model name plus Claude root session and agent identity, then sent as prompt_cache_key and Session_id.
source_confirmed.cache_interpretation: The stable key selects a performance namespace. It does not authorize reasoning replay or continuation, and reuse still requires an identical content prefix.
source_confirmed.tail_prefix_property: Keeping later steering at its chronological tail leaves the earlier translated request prefix unchanged when model-facing content before it is unchanged. Provider cache-hit amounts remain runtime-dependent.
source_confirmed.known_wrapper_edge: The message-level-system helper always adds an outer system-reminder wrapper. Already wrapped content can therefore become nested.

short_correction_matrix.interpretation: Every tested representation selected the later corrected port. This does not establish equal reliability in long or competing work.

long_history_matrix.interpretation: The model acknowledged every update, but acknowledgement did not guarantee that the next tool arguments changed. The sample is too small and synthetic to estimate a production miss rate.

limitations: The full matrix responses contain large model signatures and are not copied into this corpus; this file retains aggregate outcomes and temporary source paths.
The matrices compare representations and salience. They do not reproduce Claude Code's final-response timing window.
The direct translation claims are source-confirmed at v7.2.116 and must not be attributed to the separately pinned 7.2.112 retained-WebSocket binary lane.
